'''Capella''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Capella system/Legends|Capella system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Capella was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda]] and [[Little Capella system/Legends|Little Capella systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Capellan turg-root]]s.<ref name="Journal4" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> Mining operations there were mostly carried out by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[robominer]]s manufactured by the [[Ardan (people)|inhabitants]] of the Arda [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Capella was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
